title.narrative: Center for Investigative Reporting, core support, 2024-2027

description.narrative:
Stöd till CIN-strategi 2024-2027.
Under de kommande åren kommer Center for Investigative Reporting (CIN) att fortsätta att stärka medborgarna genom verifierad information om korruption och missbruk av makt på alla nivåer i Bosnien och Hercegovina med samma kraft och nivå av engagemang. Kontinuerliga ansträngningar kommer att göras för att säkerställa större ansvarsskyldighet myndigheter och institutionella företrädare i kampen mot korruption, genom förbättring av rättsliga och institutionella ramar och lagföring av dem som är inblandade i korrupta aktiviteter. CIN:s övergripande bidrag till detta mål definieras enligt följande: Den lagstiftande och institutionell ram kommer att förbättras för att effektivt bekämpa korruption och säkerställa lika tillgång till lag och rättvisa för alla medborgare. För att uppnå detta mål har CIN identifierat två huvudresultat av sitt arbete, vidare uppdelad i steg och resultat, vilka presenteras i resultatmatrisen. Utfall I definieras enligt följande: Medborgare har tillgång till verifierad information om korruption i den offentliga sektorn. Resultat II definieras enligt följande: Offentliga tjänstemän är redo att förbättra det juridiska och institutionella ramar i kampen mot korruption

Support to CIN Strategy 2024-2027.
In the coming years, the Center for Investigative Reporting (CIN) will continue to empower citizens through verified information about corruption and abuse of power at all levels in Bosnia and Herzegovina with the same vigor and level of engagement. Continuous efforts will be made to ensure greater accountability of authorities and institutional representatives in the fight against corruption, through the improvement of legislative and institutional frameworks and the prosecution of those involved in corrupt activities. CIN’s overall contribution to this goal is defined as follows: The legislative and institutional framework will be improved to effectively combat corruption and ensure equal access to law and justice for all citizens. To achieve this goal, CIN has identified two main outcomes of its work, further broken down into steps and results, which are presented in the Results Matrix. Outcome I is defined as follows: Citizens have access to verified information about corruption in the public sector. Outcome II is defined as follows: Public officials are ready to improve the legal and institutional framework in the fight against corruption

Continuous efforts will be made to ensure greater accountability of authorities and institutional representatives in the fight against corruption, through the improvement of legislative and institutional frameworks and the prosecution of those involved in corrupt activities. CINs overall contribution to this goal is defined as follows: The legislative and institutional framework will be improved to effectively combat corruption and ensure equal access to law and justice for all citizens. To achieve this goal, CIN has identified two main outcomes of its work Outcome I is defined as follows: Citizens have access to verified information about corruption in the public sector.
Under this outcome, CIN intends to achieve several important results:
To improve interaction with the audience in the production and distribution of its stories, CIN has decided to significantly improve and strengthen the presence of its communication channels to facilitate the audience to primarily access CINs stories via CINs platforms, and secondarily via other media. This will be achieved through detailed audience analysis and by presenting specifically tailored content to the targeted audience or specific categories of the audience at times, in ways, and via platforms that suit that group.
By the end of 2027, CIN will strive to: Increase story production to 35 stories per year Increase the number of story re-posts through CINs communication channels Increase the number of stories generated based on citizens submissions by 20%
Outcome II is defined as follows: Public officials are ready to improve the legal and institutional framework in the fight against corruption
Under this outcome, CIN plans to engage more closely with civil society representatives and other relevant actors in the professional community to collectively exert pressure on authorities and institutions to respond to findings of corrupt practices and work towards reducing opportunities for corruption and abuse of power through the improvement of legislative and institutional frameworks.
